summary: Martin Schweiger's Orbiter is a Newtonian spaceflight simulator that moved from freeware releases to an open-source MIT-licensed project with Orbiter 2024 as the current route.

entries.title: Orbiter

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Orbiter 2024 with exact addon/scenario setup documented

primary.why: Orbiter 2024 is the current release and the project is now open-source under the MIT License, making it the best maintained route for high-fidelity spaceflight simulation. Earlier 2000/2010/2016 freeware builds remain important for addon compatibility and version-history comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Use Orbiter 2024 on Windows. Record release/build, graphics client, high-resolution texture packs, addon set, scenario, vessel, time acceleration, physics/realism settings, MFDs, and whether legacy 2010/2016 addons required an older build.

secondary.exclusive_content: Legacy addon compatibility and version-history behavior
secondary.what_to_play: Use only when an addon/scenario requires it.
secondary.why: Orbiter 2024 is the current base simulator route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record addon, texture, graphics-client, and scenario state.
